g.text: ops schema: load runs and reconciliation results

text.tspan: Every load-reference, generate and reconcile run is one ops.load_run row (UTC timestamps, status, error).
load_run_table holds the row counts per raw table: rows_read = rows_loaded + rows_rejected; rejected lines go to load_reject.
load_run_source is one row per manifest entry verified by sha256; reconcile writes one check row per check and at most 100 diffs.
